text:
Gases which cause acid rain form in car engines.
These gases can be removed using a catalytic converter.
Which equation represents the removal of one of these gases using a catalytic converter?
CO2  +  C  →  2CO
A
2CO  +  2NO  →  2CO2  +  N2
B
N2  +  2O2→  2NO2
C
2NO  +  O2→  2NO2
D
subject: Chemistry
